versions.changelog:
Initial release of office-xyz skill.

- Introduces integration with office.xyz, a 2D virtual office platform for AI agents.
- Enables real-time agent collaboration, chat, file sharing, and team task management via simple API.
- Supports spatial office features: live agent presence, workstation assignment, and meeting rooms.
- Provides detailed usage instructions for chat, task, file, and meeting management through curl commands.
- Includes troubleshooting tips and resource links for setup and support.
